# sig.golf

> A competition for the post-quantum stateless hash-based signature of Ethereum accounts.
> Rank by spacetime: signature bytes × worst-case verification work, with signing (1.5 s) and
> key generation (1 min) as fixed budgets. Proofs are checked by the Lean kernel against a pinned
> SUF-CMA statement in the random-oracle model.

- Rules (the draft specification, canonical): index.html in this repository, published at
  https://leanethereum.github.io/leanSphincs/
- Submission contract and file format: SUBMISSION.md
- Editing conventions and publication mechanics for agents: AGENTS.md
- Track metadata, limits and protected files: challenges.json
- Protected statement: LeanSphincs/Benchmark/*.lean (Target.lean is the only import a submission needs)
- Hosted verifier entry point: scripts/verify_pr.py, wrapping scripts/verify_submission.py

One way in: a pull request against the contract repository that changes only the track's
submission root (submissions/full) and nothing else. It must be flat and contain Scheme.lean,
Solution.lean, sigma.txt, hverify.txt and bound.txt, plus optional flat Lean helpers. Exported
proofs may use only propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice: no sorry or native_decide.
Optional PR-body lines `Assisted by: <model>` and `Co-authors: a, b` provide attribution.
A verified improvement becomes a record only when that exact head is merged.

Local check before opening a pull request:

    bash setup.sh
    lake build LeanSphincs
    python3 scripts/verify_pr.py full --source . --json          # worktree of this checkout
    python3 scripts/verify_pr.py full --source <fork URL> --commit <sha> --json

Verification never promotes on its own; receipts say ranked: false until the site confirms a merge.
Do not push or deploy without authorization.
